title: pretty SCARLEN|Plus Size Satin Midi Wedding Guest Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your style with this chic satin midi dress designed for plus-size figures. The soft satin fabric drapes beautifully, offering a smooth, luxurious look. The tailored fit highlights your curves, while the practical side pockets add convenience without compromising elegance. Perfect for weddings or special events, this dress balances comfort and sophistication.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
